g.text: MarieRank4Convo8 begins.

g.title: j2786051379
g.text: Check boolean MarieOtak1

g.title: j3474795979
g.text: Drifter, the more and more I sit with the knowledge of Monsieur Necraloid and Monsieur Otak the more it troubles me...

g.title: j2786051379->j3474795979
g.text: true

g.title: j1243648436
g.text: Drifter, may I speak to you ?

g.title: j2786051379->j1243648436
g.text: false

g.title: j2104925443
g.text: How so?

g.title: j1729362330
g.text: What specifically is the issue?

g.title: j1985778270
g.text: Of course. What is it?

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j3719104782
g.text: I asked Monsieur Necraloid if the skull that adorned him belonged to a living soul at one point or another or not.

g.title: j3259375424
g.text: I find myself curious as to why there is another face upon his back that resembles a child's scrawl.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j1661557441
g.text: And Monsieur Necraloid told me that it was "his" skull, though he admitted Monsieur Loid was the "original." Monsieur Loid interjected to tell me that it was a "replicated" version of his own skull.

g.title: j2182221102
g.text: I inquired with Monsieur Necraloid and Monsieur Loid both, and neither wished to speak of it, they only told me a name. Otak. And it was with great sadness that they uttered it.

g.title: j24737604
g.text: How can that be ? And what does "replicated" mean ? Is it a real skull ou bien c'est un faux ? Why would Monsieur Necraloid and Monsieur Loid have differing answers ?

g.title: j259395349
g.text: So here I am, speaking with you, in hopes you might be able to aid me.

g.title: j1636318025
g.text: I suppose from Necraloid's perspective, it is his skull. That's true. But it is, from Loid's perspective, a replica.

g.title: j2033455517
g.text: I honestly don't know what it's made out of. It could be bone. Or some kind of polymer...

g.title: j4151605888
g.text: I think the root of the question you're grappling with is, "is Necraloid real," not "is the skull real."

g.title: j3742814302
g.text: Will you tell me the story of poor Monsieur Otak ?

g.title: j2434131181
g.text: I think that is what troubles me. It is the way the two gentlemen consider its origin. One believes it to be sacro-saint, the other a copie.

g.title: j1962604073
g.text: I do not know if it is what the skull is made of that troubles me so. It is its origin. Or perhaps the way the two gentlemen consider its origin. One believes it to be sacro-saint, the other a copie.

g.title: j3256307528
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j591329032
g.text: Otak used to be an Archimedean, an Orokin scientist and academic. What's happened to him isn't exactly the happiest story.

g.title: j3408858168
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j3533567721
g.text: Oui ! You are right, that is the heart of it - or the skull of it - ha. One believes it to be sacro-saint, the other a copie.

g.title: j3091626273
g.text: By all accounts he was a genius, and the mind behind the harnessing of argon crystals.

g.title: j1586908209
g.text: How can Monsieur Necraloid own a soul, when he does not own his own bones ?

g.title: j3408858168->j1586908209
g.text: MarieCephalonSoul

g.title: j1526720452
g.text: Is this more proof that Monsieur Necraloid has no soul ?

g.title: j3408858168->j1526720452
g.text: MarieCephalonNoSoul

g.title: j4186070577
g.text: I know you are uncertain if Monsieur Necraloid can own a soul. But I do not know how he could, when he does not own his own bones.

g.title: j3408858168->j4186070577
g.text: MarieCephalonUnsure

g.title: j4059031358
g.text: I am speaking of a very elaborate piece of technology made to resemble a man, am I not ? A phonographe, many many times more complex.

g.title: j3408858168->j4059031358
g.text: false

g.title: j148019023
g.text: Which are harnessed from the Void - they're the reason we can create a lot of the powerful Warframes and weapons we make.

g.title: j1831920355
g.text: Maybe you're right. Maybe they really are just copies of people. But I'm not sure, and we have to treat them as if they are people, anyway.

g.title: j1219713834
g.text: I think Necraloid is the exception, not the rule. He was made as a replica of a person, not from a person.

g.title: j1306403827
g.text: You're right. It's probably better, and more humane, if they aren't actually souls trapped inside elaborate science...

g.title: j2672993816
g.text: Necraloid may not have a soul, but he's unique. Other Cephalons, like Otak, do. They were destroyed in how they were made.

g.title: j2028798980
g.text: You're right. So what would you have me do about it?

g.title: j2139696776
g.text: You're right. They don't. But it doesn't mean we can go around treating them poorly.

g.title: j364391978
g.text: I don't know if you're right or not. But they can still think, and feel, and we can't treat them like things.

g.title: j1517977342
g.text: Necraloid has a soul. All Cephalons do.

g.title: j2587678512
g.text: He specialized in crystallography. And his works were archived here, in the laboratories.

g.title: j1622842517
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonUnsure is now true.

g.title: j1721598055
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonSoul is now true.

g.title: j649560426
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonNoSoul is now true.

g.title: j260964343
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonSoul is now true.

g.title: j483842496
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonNoSoul is now true.

g.title: j3482288556
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonNoSoul is now true.

g.title: j1888591591
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonUnsure is now true.

g.title: j2566840366
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonSoul is now true.

g.title: j852946920
g.text: For some reason, I don't know why, he was turned into a Cephalon, and given his own necraloid shell.

g.title: j1123955131
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonNoSoul is now false.

g.title: j2549294783
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonUnsure is now false.

g.title: j1331520439
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonSoul is now false.

g.title: j504241984
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1500307801
g.text: Oh, do not think I mean for you to be cruel ! Non ! Treasure them, for they are precious, and through no fault of their own are they as they are !

g.title: j271984586
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2459455604
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1563358045
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3306088956
g.text: Not all Cephalons were made as a punishment. But things went... poorly here on Deimos, and he was badly damaged.

g.title: j2139285889
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonSoul is now false.

g.title: j1114865556
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonNoSoul is now false.

g.title: j1651493055
g.text: Boolean MarieCephalonUnsure is now false.

g.title: j4281281849
g.text: More proof that the devil and his ilk were right to be condemned. But, perhaps you are right about Otak and his kind, or perhaps it brings you peace to believe so.

g.title: j341173922
g.text: And I may be wrong, when all is said and done. There is never any harm in showing kindness and respect.

g.title: j3120890820
g.text: Perhaps you are right, but I do not think the Orokin devils knew more of the workings of the soul than we. They were no great gods.

g.title: j3526767153
g.text: Perhaps you are right, or perhaps it brings you peace to believe so.

g.title: j3998308863
g.text: Pauvre petit...

g.title: j1657906571
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3042654732
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3248634465
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3617617672
g.text: I am going to go back to braiding a crown of flowers for Monsieur Necraloid, regardless. He fussed, but I will not be told non !

g.title: j3134774711
g.text: Boolean MarieOtak1 is now true.

g.title: j1261162356
g.text: Oui, that is very wise. I am merely thinking aloud and wondering to you what they are. You are quite right, there is never any harm in showing kindness and respect.

g.title: j663983514
g.text: Perhaps you are right. And I hope you are ! Whatever the case may be, we must be kind - for they are thinking creatures. And what may think, may feel.

g.title: j2311952194
g.text: Whatever the case may be, we must be kind - for they are thinking creatures. And what may think, may feel.

g.title: j909444529
g.text: That's adorable.

g.title: j1126572744
g.text: Crown of flowers?

g.title: j2752110903
g.text: Have fun.

g.title: j3951815689
g.text: Check boolean LoidFamilyComplete

g.title: j3673470761
g.text: And we may be wrong, when all is said and done. There is never any harm in showing kindness and respect.

g.title: j366938164
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2807121465
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2171684285
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1755714895
g.text: How did this come up?

g.title: j3951815689->j1755714895
g.text: true

g.title: j3951815689->j1755714895
g.text: false

g.title: j1120688605
g.text: I hope someday you can meet him.

g.title: j3951815689->j1120688605
g.text: false

g.title: j2511082154
g.text: Merci ! À la revoyure !

g.title: j2774497613
g.text: Oh ! It is one of the Rites of Lua. On the anniversary of the passing of a soul, one braids a crown or wreath flowers and places it atop their skull or atop their grave.

g.title: j1498968930
g.text: Merci, I will ! À la revoyure !

g.title: j664598391
g.text: Oui. But it is not his silence that troubles me, I suppose. I asked Monsieur Necraloid if the skull that adorned him belonged to a living soul at one point or another or not.

g.title: j2461018720
g.text: Traditional crypts for the dead often had the bodies exposed, oui ? So you could do this. I think some of this survived, even still.

g.title: j265154527
g.text: I see it reflected in some of the Orokin artwork, with their love of skulls.

g.title: j3195874128
g.text: That does explain a lot.

g.title: j1844388549
g.text: The more things change, huh?

g.title: j2350772620
g.text: I think Daughter has tried to do that before, you'll make her jealous.

g.title: j533366216
g.text: Oui ! So much time has passed, and yet the influence remains. It brings me happiness to know even tiny pieces remain.

g.title: j2162983461
g.text: Oui ? Then I look forward to the day I can meet her ! I will tell her I gave him no quarter.

g.title: j1143466773
g.text: Faux skull or no, Monsieur Necraloid should have a crown. And it makes him so shy when I dote upon him ! He would blush if he could, I think. And this makes me smile.

g.title: j4101990552
g.text: À la revoyure !
